attributes.residual:
THE PROFITABILITY COLUMN IS CONFIRMED AS A RANKER AND REFUTED AS A PREDICTOR OF CLOSURE. Computed over all 41 live rows, |insn_delta - missing_sites| = 0 for exactly 8: ControllerMessageBox(real 45), get_vmu_directory(65), sndFxStartVoice(93), fn_8005E90C(143), AudioLoadPart(171), player_get_from_save(171), HealthMeterUpdate(261), fn_8005BA1C(627). But the run's four CLOSURES came from BOTH tiers -- fn_8005E90C and AudioLoadPart are prof-0 rows, while PlayerDoWeapTrail(prof -1) and PlyrSfxDoDamage(prof -1) are not -- and two prof-0 rows (ControllerMessageBox, player_get_from_save) did not move at all. So a prof-0 row is NOT 'the pair is the whole residual': it means the COUNTS balance, which two cancelling defects also produce (PlayerDoWeapTrail's baseline was exactly that -- a missing pair and an extra mr summing to parity at T140/O140). Use the column to rank, not to filter.
